snippet.title: Chhaava | Official Trailer | Vicky K | Rashmika M | Akshaye K | Dinesh Vijan | Laxman U | 14th Feb
snippet.description:
Dinesh Vijan and Maddock Films present the trailer of Hindi Cinema's biggest spectacle ever - #Chhaava

Yeh Sher Shiva ka Chhaava shor nahin karta, seedha shikaar karta hai! 

#ChhaavaTrailer #ChhaavaTrailerOutNow

Releasing in cinemas on 14th February.

Maddock Films presents #Chhaava

Cast: Vicky Kaushal, Rashmika Mandanna, Akshaye Khanna, Ashutosh Rana, Divya Dutta, Vineet Kumar Singh, Diana Penty, Santosh Juvekar
Produced By Dinesh Vijan
Directed By: Laxman Utekar 
Co-Producers: Sharada Karki Jalota, Pooja Prem Patheja 
Original Songs & Background Score : A R Rahman
Adapted Story, Screenplay By: Laxman Utekar, Rishi Virmani, Kaustubh Savarkar, Unman Bankar, Omkar Mahajan 
Dialogue: Rishi Virmani
Director Of Photography: Saurabh Goswami (Isc) 
Lyrics: Irshad Kamil 
Production Design: Subrata Chakraborty, Amit Ray 
Editor: Manish Pradhan 
Associate Producer: Sanjeev Mishra 
Action Director:  Parvez Shaikh, Todor Lazaroy
Costume Designer: Sheetal Iqbal Sharma 
Director Of Choreography: Vijay Ganguly 
Associate Executive Producer: Shraddha S Thorat 
Sound Designer: Bishwadeep Chatterjee 
Re-Recording Mixer: Alok De 
Chief Assistant Director: Eeshaan Roy 
Script Supervisor: Amod Burande 
Associate Director (Shoot) : Jatin Bajaj 
Art Directors: Avijit Gosh, Dilip Ganpati Rokade, Rajat Pathare
Line Producer: Rajdeep Munendra Gupta & Anand Mishra 
Casting By: Anti Casting 
Post Production: The Post Co 
Di: Prime Focus Ltd 
Di Colorist: Ashirwad Hadkar 
Prosthetic Designer: Preetisheel Singh D'souza 
Makeup Designer: Shrikant Desai 
Vfx: Assemblage Entertainment & Redefine 
Vfx Supervisors: Gary Brown & Simon Frame (Assemblage) & Somesh Samit Ghosh (Redefine) 
Publicity Design: Himanshu & Rahul Nanda (H-One) 
Music On: Sony Music 
Action Storyboard & Title Card Design: Aniket Mitra
Additional Marathi Lyrics: Kshitij Patwardhan 
Local Line Producer (Wai):  Shri Balaji Films Production Wai Kali Kalidas Dongare
